quiz_plan.promise: the quiz plays the page's promise: a brand quiz a visitor can take, whose results answer what the H1 says it builds

plan.angle: The top 10 is logo-guessing trivia (Sporcle, JetPunk, LogoQuiz, BuzzFeed) and one brand-personality quiz from a brand strategist, with no builder in sight. A visitor takes an eight-question brand quiz on this page and gets one of five brand personality results, then sees what businesses do with a brand quiz they own: a brand strategist turns results into booked calls, a design studio compares a client team's answers before a rebrand workshop, a coffee roaster runs brand trivia at a trade show booth, and a newsletter counts results to plan its issues. Every finished quiz lands in a database the owner keeps.
tab_stories: Rosalind Achterberg, who runs a candle shop, takes Fennimore Brand Studio's brand quiz, lands on Sincerity, and strategist Thaddeus Mbeki gets a Slack alert with her 8 answers before she books a 20-minute call from the result screen.

Quillwork Design sends the brand quiz to the 6 owners of Ledgerwood Hardware before a rebrand, and designer Ines Valcourt sees 3 Ruggedness, 2 Sincerity, and 1 Competence results before Thursday's workshop.

Bramblecup Coffee runs a 10-question brand trivia quiz about its own beans on a tablet at its trade show booth, 212 visitors finish it, and the 38 who score 10 of 10 go into the drawing for a year of coffee.

The Wordmark Letter sends its brand quiz to subscribers, 1,480 finish it in one quarter, Sincerity leads with 520, and editor Paloma Strand turns those 520 Sincerity results into an issue written for them.
